Trail Access Grants Program

The Trail Access Grants program is a 100% reimbursement program for trail projects that increase access to trail opportunities for people with disabilities. Eligible applicants include local (city, county, town) or tribal governments or recreation departments and code-designated park and recreation authorities. Funding for the program comes from Virginia tax payer donations of all or portions of their income tax returns to the Open Space Conservation and Recreation Fund. Future grant rounds are pending accumulation of contributions to the fund. At current accumulation rates, the next grant round is not anticipated until 2027 or later.

Previous Grant Rounds

  • 2021 Trail Access Grants Manual. The manual contains program details, eligibility information and scoring criteria used for the 2021 grant round.

Previously Funded Projects

Town of Shenandoah – ADA Nature Trail

Scope: Grade, pave, stripe, and install ADA-compliant parking space and pave approximately .25 mile, 36 inch wide trail at Big Gem Park; install trail information signs and trailside benches.

Funding: $38,339.95

Completion: May 2023

Scott County – Keith Memorial Park Trail Section ADA Upgrade

Scope: Pave approximately 600 feet of Keith Memorial Park’s loop trail in Nickelsville, VA with a minimum tread width of 60 inches.

Funding: $34,529.89

Completion: September 2022

Town of Leesburg Department of Parks and Recreation – Potomac Crossing Park Trailhead


Scope: Installation of approximately 500 feet of crushed stone trail to connect Potomac Crossing Park trailhead and existing trail, concrete access route to portable toilet pad, trailhead information sign, and dog waste station.

Funding: $23,000.00

Completion: January 2023

City of Roanoke – Roanoke River Blueway Access at Bennington

Scope: Construction of 10 foot-wide concrete access route and water access point on Roanoke River Blueway from Roanoke River Greenway.

Funding: $50,000.00

Completion: October 2023

Information on any future grants rounds will be posted to this website. If you have additional questions or would like to be added to the contact list for grant round announcements, please contact Recreation Grants Coordinator Kellie Seaton at contact@example.virginia.gov or or 804-786-1119.
